name: Iverron's Antidote
objectiveText: Collect 7 Hyacinth Mushrooms , 4 Moonpetal Lilies , and 1 Webwood Ichor for Dirania Silveshine in Shadowglen. Hyacinth Mushroom  ( 7 ) Moonpetal Lily  ( 4 ) Webwood Ichor  ( 1 )

comments.body:
57,32  is the ichor 
54,43  is  mushrooms (they can be found in other places as well)
58,36 for moonpetals.  They are around the water.

If you are using Questie it will show you that the Mushrooms can be found inside the spider cave. I cleared the whole cave and there is nothing there. Instead head south-west to the Grelkins (54, 42). They are small purplish mushrooms which can be found at the roots of the bigger purple trees.
the grellkin drop the mushrooms they have a 100% drop rate.
The Lilies are near a pond southwest of Dirania. The mushrooms are along the cliff sides, and the Ichor is a common drop from the spider cave to the north.
replies: Mushrooms can be found on the grimlin looking mobs too.
The lilies are to the NORTHwest of the lady ~ they're on the way from the chick to the caves where the spiders are.

comments.body:
For the mushrooms, look around trees, they'll be in groups of three or so.
For the moonpetal lily. go to the pond North of the town, they are flowers surrounding the East pond.
Kill spiders near camp for Ichor.

Mushroom's found on Grelkin at loc 54, 43

Lilies are in area 57,37 near the pond.

Ickor is loc 56, 32

[b][item=10639][/b] can be found along grellkin's villages and dropped by them as well.
[b][item=10641][/b], search for them behind the Shadowglen tree, they are all near small lakes.
[b][item=10640][/b] is dropped by spiders, you will found them around spder cave north of Shadowglen.

Bring all these back to [b]Dirania Silvershine[/b] to complete the quest.

[b][quest=3521][/b] - www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ksx5xnDkQi0
If your timer runs out just go back to her at 60.8 42.0

Continue Quest Text (from Dirania Silvershine):

"Please, collect the ingredients, <name>. Iverron needs our help."

Complete Quest Text (from Dirania Silvershine):

"Thank Elune that you have gathered these ingredients so quickly!

"In just a moment, I will have the antidote prepared."
